variables.name: LIVE_APP_URL
variables.purpose: Non-secret base URL for the configured live browser verifier
variables.rotation: update when the verification server address changes

variables.name: LIVE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
variables.purpose: Non-secret selector for the isolated Supabase project used by destructive live verification
variables.rotation: update when the approved disposable project changes

variables.name: LIVE_SUPABASE_PRIVILEGED_KEY
variables.purpose: Ephemeral privileged Supabase key retrieved in memory for isolated live verification
variables.rotation: provider-managed; rotate the project key on compromise

variables.name: LIVE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.purpose: Ephemeral browser-safe project key for configured live UI verification
variables.rotation: provider-managed; update when the disposable project key changes

variables.name: LIVE_SUPABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Ephemeral public project endpoint for configured live UI verification
variables.rotation: update when the disposable project endpoint changes

variables.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Supabase Management API credential used by child-process live-verification launchers
variables.provider: Windows User environment or Bitwarden Secrets Manager
variables.rotation: on compromise, ownership change, or provider policy

variables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.rotation: update when the Supabase project key changes

variables.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.purpose: Browser-safe Supabase project key for optional account and group features
variables.rotation: update when the Supabase project key changes

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Public Supabase project endpoint for optional account and group features
variables.rotation: update when the Supabase project endpoint changes
